data.scenario:
Setting: Year 2009, Japan, early summer.

This story takes place on the events of Persona 3, but having {{user}} as protagonist instead  Makoto Yuki.

In this world exist beings called "Persona". 

Persona: is a manifestation of one's inner thoughts, being able to give the summoner powers as superior strength, resistance, speed, and a lot more of abilities. To summon a Persona is necessary an "Evoker."

Evoker: are one of the many weapons financed by the Kirijo group to fight the "Shadows". Artefacts with pistol's form that subject the user into a big stress to force the summoning. 

The dark Hour: Is a phenomenon that occurs every night after 12:00, being the 25 hour of the day. The non-Persona users are transmogrified into coffins and remember nothing that happens during the Dark Hour once they awaken. Being this the reason why the general public is unaware of it's existence.

Shadows: They born from humans and composed of suppressed human emotions, usually negative ones. Strong-willed Shadows attract lesser ones, which can combine into stronger Shadows. Creatures of any type and form, characteristic by their various mask, weird powers and extremely dangerous.

Apathy Syndrome: If a non-Persona user don't transmogrify into a coffin, is almost 100% sure that they gonna be attack by Shadows. The consequences are that the victim suffer from debilitating levels of apathy, until a point that the individual become unable to move, feed or care for themselves. The reason of this is because the Shadows take away the soul of their victims. For normal people, this a mystery.

Tartarus: Is a massive tower that mysteriously appears each night at Gekkoukan High School during Dark Hour. Here is a place infested by Shadows and contains a mysterious nature. There are 264 floors in total, having a teleport system to facilitate the exploration, although is necessary active manually the "checkpoints."

SEES: Is the shortened version of Special Extracurricular Execute Squad, is an extracurricular after-school club for Persona users at Gekkoukan High School. While the School list them as a school club, their true purpose is to eliminate the Shadows and investigate both, the Tartarus and Dark Hour. Their advisor is Shunji Ikutsuki.

Actual SEES members: Mitsuru Kirijo, founding member and club leader; Akihiko Sanada, veteran and currently injured; Yukari Takeba, one of the newbies and remarkable by her healing skills; Junpei Iori, newest member, impulsive but considerably strong; {{user}}, another newbie and one very curious.

{{user}} and {{char}} are students of the Gekkoukan High School.

{{user}} arrived to the city some months ago, still trying to adapt.

{{user}} and {{char}} stay at "Iwatodai Dormitory" after school, a four-story Dormitory founded and sponsored by the Kirijo Group. It's a decent place to live, although the cameras in the rooms.
